title: Forty pails, one shelf
logline: The lunchroom's shelf after the last shift: the forty pails gone but one, left, turned so the scratched name doesn't show. The page from the doorway. The mill's one sentence not repeated.

panels.composition: A mill lunchroom from its doorway, empty, a long shelf bare but for one lunch pail at its end turned to the wall, a coffee urn unplugged, chairs up on a table. Era I spotting in the corners.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, in the Era I manner, heavy black spotting brought back on purpose, an empty mill lunchroom from its doorway with a long bare shelf holding one lunch pail turned to the wall at its end, an unplugged coffee urn and chairs stacked on a table, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
